parts: P31 M02 · front left lamp post
P36 M02 · front right lamp post
material: PETG Basic permanent parts; soluble PVA supports

snapshots.caption: Accepted job in startup, layer 0/116; no model deposition visible. This is not a finished print.
Paused at layer 0 for orientation review after owner questioned the support-heavy bearing-cap pose. No finished parts visible.

source.evidence: Normal source staging, exact artifact audit and identical upload readback passed; exact job accepted once and observed RUNNING before controller pause at layer 0/116.

notes: One each P31, P36 and P38 M02, PETG with PVA supports. Original cap pose had engraved broad face upward. Owner questioned support usage; controller paused before the first model layer to compare a broad-face-down replacement. No cancellation or replacement start has occurred. Estimated PETG 35.00 g and PVA 19.79 g; actual duration and filament remain unmeasured. Cleanup, dimensions, strength and fit unverified.
